verdict.rationale: Tilled is a payments platform with dashboards and a reporting console, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions. It documents only conventional Dashboard management (merchants, payouts, disputes, subscriptions) and a reporting console, none of which involve AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
